newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud to invest PLN 100 mln in two years.
newsitem.headline: Exbud to invest PLN 100 mln in two years.

text.p: Polish construction firm Exbud SA plans to invest about 100 million zlotys in the next two years, notably to purchace other building firms, an Exbud official said on Wednesday.

"We want to allot 100 million zlotys for investment and we expect revenue from our current share issue to be one of the main sources of financing of the two-year programme," Robert Oskard, Exbud's planning and economic director, told a news conference.
Oskard said Exbud planned to purchase general construction firms as well as specialised firms such as installation companies, electrical firms and road builders.
In the first round Exbud's share issue held between July 22 and August 12, the firm sold 729,613 shares, or 36.5 percent of the two million shares offered at 23 zlotys each.
The company will offer the remaining shares to its shareholders at a second leg from September 2 to September 16.
Oskard said all shares remaining after the second leg will be offered to domestic and foreign institutional investors recomended by issue manager IB Austria Securities SA.
Any shares remaining after this will be offered to investors chosen by Exbud's management.
